page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance trade-off between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression ranking in the bottom 10%. However, the 32 dedicated cores compensate in parallel workloads, achieving average performance in multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also register in the average tier, alongside Passmark CPU and memory scores.

This instance is suitable for workloads that benefit from multi-threaded processing but do not require high single-core clock speeds or local storage. Applicable use cases include static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and small-to-medium language model inference, all of which achieved average benchmark ratings. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the use of older Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors provides a dense allocation of dedicated cores and memory at a lower hardware tier, making it a viable option for parallelized legacy workloads where cutting-edge single-thread performance is not required.
